scripts.build:strict: npm run check:cwd && npm --prefix scripts install && npm --prefix scripts run validate && npm run build && npm --prefix scripts run validate:post
scripts.gate: astro check && npm --prefix scripts run gate:all
scripts.deploy: npm run build && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN -u CF_API_TOKEN wrangler deploy --env-file /dev/null
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN -u CF_API_TOKEN wrangler versions upload --env-file /dev/null
